inheritance.relationship: InMemoryStoreTest derives from IdentitySpecificationTestBase<PocoUser,PocoRole>; overrides CreateTestContext, AddUserStore and AddRoleStore.
The two-argument IdentitySpecificationTestBase selects its three-argument string-key form, which derives from UserManagerSpecificationTestBase<TUser,TKey>.
The actual two-argument UserManagerSpecificationTestBase is defined here. Its separate one-argument string-key convenience form is not an extra factory layer in this target's inheritance chain.

ordinaryRoleFixtureDispatch.operation: CanGetUsersInRole calls CreateTestContext once, CreateManager(context) once and CreateRoleManager(context) once. It supplies no service collections or configureServices callback.

CreateTestContext constructs one fresh InMemoryStore<PocoUser,PocoRole>. The user-store and role-store overrides register the supplied same context object as their singleton instance, rather than constructing independent stores.

Inherited CreateManager creates a ServiceCollection when omitted, preserves a non-null supplied context, dispatches virtual SetupIdentityServices, invokes the optional callback afterwards, builds a provider and requests UserManager<TUser>.

For InMemoryStoreTest the virtual call selects this override: AddIdentity<TUser,TRole> and default token providers, then AddUserStore and AddRoleStore using the passed context, followed by logging registrations.

CreateRoleManager independently creates its own omitted ServiceCollection, preserves the same supplied context, calls the same SetupIdentityServices override, builds another provider and requests RoleManager<TRole>.

baseDefaultDispatch.observation: The base SetupIdentityServices implementation forwards to virtual SetupBuilder. The base builder calls AddIdentityCore<TUser>, default token providers, AddUserStore and logging.

identityOverride.observation: Its SetupBuilder override explicitly calls base.SetupBuilder and then AddRoles<TRole>, AddRoleStore and role logging.

setupBuilderDistinction.ordinaryRoleFixture: The ordinary CreateManager path selects IdentitySpecificationTestBase.SetupIdentityServices directly. It does NOT also execute the base SetupIdentityServices expression or either SetupBuilder body. Do not double-count these alternative setup paths.
setupBuilderDistinction.otherConsumers: Direct SetupBuilder consumers and other subclasses are not broadened into ordinary role/global-passkey traffic.

lifetime.whyShared: Both separate compositions register the very same non-null context object supplied by the fixture. They are NOT one shared service provider, and their instance registrations are NOT the separate implementation-type registrations in ControllerTest.

backingData.observation: _users is an instance dictionary and Users exposes its Values.AsQueryable().
_roles is an instance dictionary and CreateAsync inserts into that instance.

lifetime.defaultContextBehavior: CreateManager without a context requests a fresh CreateTestContext; this target override constructs a fresh store. A non-null caller-supplied context is reused. Other caller-supplied collections/callbacks can change composition, so there is no all-callers invariant.
